units.source_text: 却说已故皇太子与六条妃子所生的女儿，即将赴伊势神宫当斋宫[\[3\]](#part1338.html#m3)了。

en.t: Now the daughter born to the late Crown Prince and the Rokujo lady was about to go to the Ise Shrine to serve as the Saigu.

units.source_text: 六条妃子早就计虑：

en.t: The Rokujo lady had long been thinking it over:

units.source_text: 源氏大将的爱情很不可靠，

en.t: Genji the Captain's love was very unreliable,

units.source_text: 况且让这幼女独自前往，也不放心，

en.t: and besides, she could not feel at ease sending the young girl there alone,

units.source_text: 不如以照顾幼女为由，跟她同赴伊势吧。

en.t: so it would be better to use caring for the child as a reason and go with her to Ise.

units.source_text: 桐壶院闻此消息，对源氏公子说：

en.t: When the Kiritsubo Retired Emperor heard this news, he said to Prince Genji:

units.source_text: “吾弟在世之日，最宠爱这位妃子。

en.t: When my younger brother was alive, he cherished this lady above all others.

units.source_text: 你对她倘有轻率怠慢，便是对不起她。

en.t: If you treat her with any careless neglect, you will be doing her a wrong.

units.source_text: 这个斋宫，我也视同自己子女一样。

en.t: I too regard this Saigu as I would one of my own children.

units.source_text: 无论从哪方面说，都应该尊重这位妃子。

en.t: From every point of view, you ought to show this lady respect.

units.source_text: 像你这样任情恣意，轻薄好色，势必遭受世人讥评。”

en.t: If you go on acting as you please, frivolous and fond of women, you are sure to draw the world's criticism.

units.source_text: 说时脸色甚是不快。

en.t: As he spoke, his expression was deeply displeased.

units.source_text: 源氏公子心中也认为父皇之言有理，

en.t: Prince Genji also felt in his heart that his father's words were reasonable,

units.source_text: 只得恭恭敬敬地听训。

en.t: so he could only listen respectfully to the admonition.

units.source_text: 父皇又说：

en.t: His father then said further:

units.source_text: “你不可使对方蒙受耻辱。

en.t: You must not cause the other person to suffer humiliation.

units.source_text: 对无论何人，必须彬彬有礼。

en.t: Toward anyone at all, you must be courteous and proper.

units.source_text: 切莫教女人们怀恨于你。”

en.t: Above all, do not make women bear resentment toward you.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：

en.t: Prince Genji thought:

units.source_text: “我那大逆不道的行为，

en.t: That outrageous and unforgivable act of mine,

units.source_text: 如果被他得知，

en.t: if he were to learn of it,

units.source_text: 可不得了！”

en.t: it would be disastrous!

units.source_text: 不胜惶恐，

en.t: Overcome with fear,

units.source_text: 乘机肃然告退。

en.t: he seized the chance to withdraw solemnly.
